# cannon-es

[cannon-es](https://github.com/pmndrs/cannon-es) 0.20.0 (npm `cannon-es@0.20.0`), MIT licensed
(`LICENSE`), for what falls in the room (`room-fall.js`). Only `dist/cannon-es.js`, as published
on npm, fetched from jsDelivr: 346,256 bytes, about 74.5 KB gzipped.

`index.html` maps `cannon-es` here with the same import map as three.js. It loads with Willy, and
runs only while something falls. To update, replace the file with the same path of the new
version and run `python checks/willy-fall.py`.
